evidence.observation: Tube pressure was 3.014 Torr at 100 sccm Ar setpoint.
Pressure has risen progressively through 3.074, 3.120, and 3.190 to 3.251 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Temperature 750.2 °C and Ar flow 99.6 sccm track setpoints; heater power is stable at 45.2%, leaving the pressure rise unexplained.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null readings cannot establish atmosphere purity.

args.missing_evidence: Required exhaust O2 measurement is unavailable; obtain atmosphere verification and pressure-gauge validation, leak testing, and exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish causes of the pressure rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
